list.title: Reviews of this service
list.lead: Reviews relate to an appointment. The evidence label states what was confirmed.
list.empty: No published reviews for this service.

mine.title: My review
mine.lead: You can share your experience after the appointment ends, with your explicit consent.

proof.bookingConfirmed: Confirmed appointment — completion is not attested.
proof.completionDeclared: Completion reported by the provider — without independent verification.

moderation.pending: Awaiting moderation. This content is not published yet.
moderation.removed: This content was removed by moderation.

serviceReviews.withdrawn: You withdrew this review. It cannot be republished.

form.title: Share my experience
form.description: Your review can be read by network members after moderation. Do not include contact details or exact addresses.
form.hint: Describe the service. Do not publish phone numbers, email addresses or home addresses.
form.consent: I agree to publish this review and my social name in DIASPORALE after moderation.
form.saved: Your review was saved. Its moderation status is shown in your request.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this content
withdraw.description: This content will no longer be visible. Withdrawal is final for this review or reply.

reply.title: Provider reply
reply.description: You are replying on behalf of the page. Your reply is moderated separately from the review.
reply.saved: Your reply was saved. Its moderation status is displayed separately.

report.title: Report content
report.description: Your report goes to moderation. It does not automatically remove the content for other members.
report.saved: Your report was sent to moderation.

errors.review_rating_invalid: Choose an integer rating between 1 and 5.
errors.review_body_too_short: Your review must contain at least 10 characters.
errors.review_reply_too_short: Your reply must contain at least 2 characters.
errors.review_contact_forbidden: Remove contact details from this text.
errors.review_address_forbidden: Remove the exact address from this text.
errors.review_consent_required: Your consent is required to publish this review.
errors.review_booking_required: A confirmed appointment is required to write a review.
errors.review_booking_not_finished: You can write a review after the appointment ends.
errors.review_booking_ineligible: This appointment is not eligible for a review.
errors.review_own_page: You cannot review a service provided by your own page.
errors.review_not_requester: Only the person who requested this service can review it.
errors.review_already_exists: A review already exists for this service. Find it in your request.
errors.review_version_changed: This content has changed. Close the form and read its current version.
errors.review_withdrawn: This content was withdrawn and cannot be republished.
errors.review_reply_unavailable: You can no longer reply to this review.
